name: Power Stones
summary: Rigglefuzz in the Badlands asks you to bring him Dentrium and An'Alleum Power Stones. You are to gather eight of each.

sections.title: Rigglefuzz's Request
sections.body: Rigglefuzz asks you for two kinds of power stone in the Badlands. He needs eight Dentrium Power Stones and eight An'Alleum Power Stones. Both kinds are needed for his request.

faq.answer: Rigglefuzz in the Badlands asks you to bring him the power stones.

faq.q: Which power stones does Rigglefuzz need?
faq.answer: He needs Dentrium Power Stones and An'Alleum Power Stones.

faq.q: How many Dentrium Power Stones are needed?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz asks for eight Dentrium Power Stones.

faq.q: How many An'Alleum Power Stones are needed?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz asks for eight An'Alleum Power Stones.
